nodes.label: Login Screen Illustration (login1.svg) — A flat-style vector illustration from unDraw (artist: Katerina Limpitsouni) depicting a stylized architectural or panel layout resembling a login interface backdrop. The composition features a large rounded-rectangle structure in light gray (#f2f2f2) and medium gray (#ccc) representing a building or card form, with a white inner panel suggesting a login card. Grid lines in gray divide the interior into columns and rows. A small purple circle (#6c63ff) marks a focal point (avatar/profile indicator). Two human figures in purple shirts and dark trousers stand beside the structure, each with peach/skin-toned arms and faces, suggesting users or administrators interacting with the system. Decorative organic tree/bush shapes in light gray flank the sides. A dark baseline ground line anchors the scene. The overall palette is soft: white, light gray, medium gray, purple (#6c63ff), dark near-black (#2f2e41), and peach (#ffb8b8). Style is minimal, modern, and illustration-first — typical of unDraw open-source SVG assets used in SaaS login screens.
nodes.author: Katerina Limpitsouni
